label: Lit system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Lit locus represented by DefenseFinder as a single-profile model requiring Lit__Lit.
observations: Lit branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual Lit peptidase, the Lit__Lit HMM profile, the E. coli K-12 e14 defective prophage, the T4 Gol peptide, the T4 gp23 major-head-protein context, Lit-mediated EF-Tu cleavage, Gol-activated cell death, source database rows naming one Lit model, and other phage-defense systems.
